seo_title: Keto Charcuterie Board Ideas: 21 Low-Carb Boards
description: 21 keto charcuterie board ideas at about 4 to 9 g net carbs a serving: a classic keto board, a budget board, game day, Thanksgiving and date night.
answer: A keto charcuterie board keeps the cheese and cured meat and swaps crackers, bread, jam and most fruit for low-carb dippers like cucumber, endive, celery, parmesan crisps and pork rinds. Add olives, pickles, nuts and a few berries. The 21 boards below come in at about 4 to 9 g net carbs a serving.
intro: Cheese and cured meat are already close to zero carbs, so a keto board is mostly a regular board with the crackers, jam and grapes taken off and replaced with things that do the same job.
Each idea below links to the full board: what goes on it, why it works and the timeline.

sections.heading: What to put on a keto charcuterie board

items.text: Any hard or soft cheese: cheddar, Gouda, brie, Manchego, Parmesan, blue cheese, goat cheese.
Salami, pepperoni, prosciutto, soppressata, bresaola and chorizo are all close to zero carbs.
Cucumber rounds, celery, endive leaves, radishes, parmesan crisps and pork rinds.
Olives, pickles, macadamias, pecans and almonds.
A handful of raspberries, blackberries or strawberries. Skip grapes and dried fruit.
A few squares of 85 to 90% dark chocolate instead of honey or jam.
The biggest source of carbs on a regular board.
Mostly sugar, even in small spoonfuls.
Much higher in sugar than berries.
Choose plain roasted nuts and dill pickles.

faq.a: Mostly. Cheese and cured meat are very low in carbs. The carbs on a regular board come from crackers, bread, jam, honey and fruit, so a keto board swaps those out.

faq.q: What do you use instead of crackers on a keto board?
faq.a: Cucumber rounds, celery, endive leaves, radishes, parmesan or cheddar crisps and pork rinds.

faq.q: How many carbs are in a keto charcuterie board?
faq.a: The boards above come in at about 4 to 9 g net carbs a serving. Most of those carbs come from nuts, berries and vegetables.

faq.q: What fruit can you put on a keto board?
faq.a: A few berries: raspberries, blackberries or strawberries. Skip grapes, apples and dried fruit.

faq.q: Can a keto board be dairy-free?
faq.a: Yes. The [dairy-free keto board](/boards/dairy-free-keto-board/) uses cured meats, smoked salmon, eggs, avocado, olives and nuts instead of cheese.
